english.note: This is the all-purpose term for the insulating layer of fat beneath an animal's skin.

examples.english: Penguins rely on their blubber layer to stay warm in such cold weather.
examples.traditional: 南極企鵝靠住脂肪層保暖，先至捱得過咁凍嘅天氣。
